portfolioTrack.title: Four phases, each ending in work you can show an employer
portfolioTrack.intro: You build, secure and document a complete network, the way a security team would. A written review every other week, with peer review in between, keeps each piece at a standard a hiring manager will take seriously.

phases.label: Phase 1 · Weeks 1–4
phases.name: Build
phases.text: Active Directory, DNS and a two-tier PKI, with network diagrams and build documentation.

phases.label: Phase 2 · Weeks 5–8
phases.name: Harden
phases.text: A Group Policy baseline, STIG and SCAP scan results, and a remediation report.

phases.label: Phase 3 · Weeks 9–11
phases.name: Authorize
phases.text: An RMF package: System Security Plan, POA&M and control evidence.

phases.label: Phase 4 · Week 12
phases.name: Capstone
phases.text: A recorded authorization briefing and a portfolio page you can send to employers.

portfolioTrack.outcome: You leave with a public portfolio of write-ups and diagrams, a Secure By Design certificate of completion (a record of the track you finished, not a professional certification), and a reference based on the work we reviewed together.
